column1: # The benchmark registry: every Playground sample, and what it takes to load it.
# These samples are the regression fixtures, so this table is what makes "run any bench on any
# playground" true - bench/any.sh reads it and needs no per-sample code. A sample missing from
# here is a sample nobody can benchmark, which is why the file asserts full coverage.
# sample              proto   port  path      origin              extra env (space separated, or -)
# proto:  h1    plaintext HTTP/1.1 over TCP        (wrk)
#         echo  raw stream echo, no HTTP           (Playground/Clients/Quic drives it)
#         driver a sample that GENERATES load rather than serving it
# origin: another sample started first and torn down after, for the proxy and client fixtures.
#         Its port is passed to the sample under test as PLAYGROUND_UPSTREAM_PORT.
